risk_description: Workflow redesign may shift hidden labor onto frontline employees if backstage capacity is not redesigned
Portal may improve efficiency for confident users while excluding users needing assisted service
AI triage may encode bias or reduce contestability in service routing decisions
Simplification may omit role-specific context needed for complex employee situations
Escalation model may fail if decision rights and accountability remain ambiguous
Knowledge base may decay without ownership review cadence and governance
Playbook may reduce discretion or dignity if treated as compliance script rather than recovery guide
Dashboard may privilege measurable efficiency over trust equity and employee burden
Accessibility work may be symbolic if disabled users and high-burden groups lack decision influence
Governance cadence may become reporting theater without decision authority or funding pathways
